description.value: A McDonald's fast-food restaurant on Fraser Highway in the Lower Mainland, offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, McCafé beverages, and a drive-through. As a full-service chain location it provides a reliable stop for touring cyclists needing a quick, predictable meal in the Fraser Valley corridor.
